views.review: Upper left shell and front outer parapet brick proxy is continuous with original upper front. Original front columns, beams, balcony and glazing retained. Side lower join stays neutral.
Complete upper shell brick proxy has no diagonal leftovers. Existing upper and lower aperture backs are opaque colored proxies; substantial lower mixed-material wall and deep notch remain neutral.
All original front colored surfaces retained. Original opening reveals have same-family wall/frame colors; no letters, emblems or new window geometry.
Lower viewpoint retains original portico depth, columns and balcony. Upper side brick and window families form one existing box. Geometry remains the original approximation.
Upper box support plane is uniformly brick proxy, all six original upper side apertures retain real recess geometry. Artificial lower join and existing stair bulge stay neutral.
Opposite upper box support plane and original windows follow the same material family. Lower side planes and stair bulge are deliberately neutral, without invented openings.
Original roof, two stair heads and central lightwell remain neutral. Footprint, roof void and parapet geometry unchanged. Outer parapet brick does not color inner roof surfaces.
Same camera, lighting, palette and render settings; only original face indices restored. Original neutral upper side and front opening returns visible for comparison.
Same camera, lighting, palette and render settings; only original face indices restored. Original neutral upper shell and rear windows expose repair coverage.
